Something has touched it off&mdash;and now it will spread from there.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Selonian Enclave''' was an embassy building located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]]. It served as a diplomatic site for the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]], and was where the first [[Human League]] strike was made against their kind after an attack on a Selonian neighborhood in [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2003]] reference book ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' mistakenly identifies the Selonian Enclave as being located in Bela Vistal rather than Coronet.
